## Calendar.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The chosen date (`YYYY-MM-DD`), an array of dates, or a `{ start, end }` range — depending on `mode`. Bindable.
- `onValueChange` :: Called whenever the person changes the selection.
- `mode` :: `single` picks one day, `range` a start and end, `multiple` any number of days.
- `min` :: The earliest selectable ISO date.
- `max` :: The latest selectable ISO date.
- `isDateDisabled` :: Returns true when a date cannot be selected. Combined with `min` and `max`.
- `weekStartsOn` :: Day the week starts on, 0 = Sunday through 6 = Saturday.
- `locale` :: BCP 47 locale for month names and weekday labels. Defaults to the runtime locale.
- `numberOfMonths` :: How many months to show side by side.
- `disabled` :: Blocks pointer and keyboard input.
- `label` :: Accessible name of the calendar.
- `size` :: The height of the previous and next month buttons. @default 'h-lg'
- `shape` :: The corner shape of the month buttons. @default 'round'
- `textSize` :: The scale of the month title between the arrows. @default 'text-md'
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the weekday column headings. @default 'text-xs'
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of the weekday column headings. @default 'text-muted'
- `gap` :: The space between the month header, the weekday row and the date grid. @default 'gap-sm'

## dates.ts

### `interface Ymd`

Civil dates as year / month / day integers. No timezone-sensitive Date arithmetic.

- `y` :: Full year, e.g. 2026.
- `m` :: Month, 1–12.
- `d` :: Day of the month, 1–31.

### `interface DateRange`

An inclusive range of ISO dates, used by the calendar in `range` mode.

### `const SAKAMOTO`

Sakamoto offsets — weekday of the first of each month in a non-leap year, Monday-adjusted in `weekday`.

### `function parseIso`

Parse an ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` string into a civil date, or `null` if it is not a real day.

### `function toIso`

Format a civil date as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

### `function weekday`

Day of week: 0 = Sunday, 6 = Saturday. Pure integer math (Sakamoto).

### `function today`

Today's civil date in the runtime's local zone — the one calendar users mean by "today".

### `interface CalendarCell`

- `outside` :: The cell belongs to the previous or next month, filling out the week.

### `function monthCells`

Six weeks of cells for a month view, always 42 long so the grid does not jump.

### `function weekdayLabels`

Short weekday labels for a week that starts on `weekStartsOn`, in `locale`.

### `function monthTitle`

"November 2026" (or the equivalent in `locale`).

### `function formatIso`

Format an ISO date as a local civil date in `locale`.

### `function parseInput`

Parse a typed date: ISO, locale-ordered numerics, or a month name plus day and year.

### `function inRange`

Whether `iso` lies in the inclusive range [start, end], both ISO or null.

### `function orderedRange`

Sort two ISO dates so `start` ≤ `end`.

### `interface Hms`

Civil time as hour / minute / second integers, 24-hour, no timezone.

- `h` :: Hour, 0–23.
- `m` :: Minute, 0–59.
- `s` :: Second, 0–59.

### `interface TimeRange`

An inclusive range of ISO times, used by the time range field.

### `function parseTimeIso`

Parse an ISO `HH:mm` or `HH:mm:ss` string into a civil time, or `null` if it is not a real time.

### `function toTimeIso`

Format a civil time as `HH:00`, `HH:mm`, or `HH:mm:ss` according to `granularity`.

### `function compareTime`

Compare two ISO times. Missing or invalid strings compare as 0 against each other.
